hook: A small Antarctic ice shelf sector lost over 30 cubic kilometers of ice as its pinning ice rumple let go.
hook_turn: as its pinning ice rumple let go.
summary: Small islands and ice rumples can hold back ice shelf flow. CryoSat-2 radar altimetry from 2010 to 2026 shows thinning along troughs in the Carney-Duncan sector of the Getz Ice Shelf, and Landsat images show the rumple unanchoring since 1973. The link between thinning, lost pinning, and flow change is inferred from correlated trends in one sector.
title: Sustained Ice Loss and Ice‐Shelf Flow Reorganization in the Carney‐Duncan Sector, Marie Byrd Land, West Antarctica (2010–2026)
